title: Omal's Optimization
description: omal's optimization is a lightweight Fabric modpack designed specifically for playing Minecraft Java Edition on Android devices using launchers such as PojavLauncher, Zelith, and Mojo Launcher.
body:
Omal’s Optimization is a lightweight Fabric modpack designed specifically for playing Minecraft Java Edition on Android devices using launchers such as PojavLauncher, Zelith, and Mojo Launcher.

This modpack focuses on performance, and optimization, giving mobile players a faster and smoother experience

The Included Mods are as follows

Lithium — game logic and tick optimization
    •    FerriteCore — RAM usage reduction
    •    Krypton — network optimization
    •    Dynamic FPS — reduces FPS when unfocused, saves battery
    •    Immediately Fast — render optimization

Notes:
The Renderer recommended for android devices is GL4ES.
